fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Owning Project.ItemId. Echoed on every PATCH — same requiredOn rule as Feature.projectId.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL segment under /projects/:projectId/:slug (dev/stg/prod/uat or custom). Renameable — identity is ItemId, not this value. Uniqueness per project is enforced app-side (AddEnvironmentModal / rename modal); the cloud has no unique constraint.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Display text for the env chip/badge (e.g. 'Local Dev'). Replaces Project.envLabelOverrides — the override map is retired once every env row carries its own label.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Hex color for the chip tint and badge accent. Empty string falls back to the canonical env palette.

fields.name: order
fields.description: Sparse stringified integer ('0','10','20') controlling chip order — same convention as TestCase.order. Canonical envs seed as 0/10/20/30.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: dev | stg | prod | uat | custom — semantic kind used for icon and defaults. 'custom' for user-added envs.
